description: **The reserved flags now work after the command name.** `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--quiet` and `--verbose` are recognized anywhere in argv, exactly like `--help` -- `myapp deploy --dry-run` used to fail with `unknown flag` and now works, at any group nesting depth. A bare `--` still ends recognition, and a passthrough command's args are still forwarded to the child untouched.
